This model uses the language you type in instead of a guess. Short phrases become much more reliable. Select it when its list has your languages.
This model uses the language you type in, the same as the 40 language model. It covers only the European languages, so the download is smaller.
This model uses the language you type in and has the accuracy of the Small model. It is the most accurate model that still fits on a phone.
This model balances accuracy and speed. It covers every language that Whisper knows. Select it if the Small model is too slow.
This is the fastest multilingual model. It works well with clear speech, but noise reduces the accuracy.
This model gives the best accuracy that still runs well on a phone. It handles accents and background noise better than the Base model. It covers every language that Whisper knows.
This model gives almost desktop accuracy. Each phrase takes several seconds. The model uses almost one gigabyte of memory while it runs.
This is one of the most accurate Whisper models, but it is too large for most phones. The download is 1.5 GB. Only a device with a large amount of memory can load it.

This model recognises the language you speak much better than the smaller models. Select it if a smaller model transcribes your speech as the wrong language. It is a big download, and each phrase takes several seconds.

This is the most accurate Whisper model, and the best at recognising which language you speak. The download is 1.5 GB. Only a device with a large amount of memory can load it. The Turbo model is almost as accurate and is half the size.
This model handles %1$s only. It has no language detection step. This makes it faster and a little more accurate than a multilingual model of the same size.
This model gives the best accuracy that still runs well on a phone. It uses the language you dictate in, in any of the 99 languages that Whisper knows, and it listens for your own words.

This model balances accuracy and speed. It uses the language you dictate in, in any of the 99 languages that Whisper knows, and it listens for your own words. Select it if the Small model is too slow.
This is the fastest model. It works well with clear speech, but noise reduces the accuracy. It uses the language you dictate in and listens for your own words.
This model is almost as accurate as the largest model, at half the size. Each phrase takes several seconds, and it cannot translate.
This model gives almost desktop accuracy. Each phrase takes several seconds. The model uses almost one gigabyte of memory while it runs.
This is the most accurate Whisper model. The download is 1.1 GB. Only a device with a large amount of memory can load it. The Turbo model is almost as accurate and is half the size.
